description: A musician group or other entity credited with creating or performing music
A geographic region such as a country city or administrative division used to locate artists and labels
A reusable credit grouping that combines one or more artists into a single attribution
A single artist entry within an artist credit including its ordering and join phrase
A grouping of releases that represent the same logical album single or other product
A specific issue of a release group such as a particular CD vinyl or digital edition
A distinct audio recording that can appear on one or more tracks across releases
A single playable item on a medium linking a recording to its position on a release
A physical or digital carrier within a release such as a CD or vinyl disc
A distinct intellectual or musical work such as a composition song or score
A company or imprint responsible for publishing or distributing releases
An external web resource linked to MusicBrainz entities through relationships
